decision.reason: not-allowed: Creative Commons Corporation ei ole vastuussa tämän Public License -lisenssin käytöstä.

explanation: This is a Finnish translation of a Creative Commons Public License. The excerpt has no title and no ShareAlike section, so the version and share-alike term cannot be confirmed from this file. Under the refuse-when-in-doubt rule it is refused as a possible CC-BY-SA-4.0 grey-zone text.
